card.name: Digits inside decimal numbers in tables
card.fires_on: Single digits or decimal points inside numbers such as 0.9, 2.2 or 1.6%, often in dosimetry-style tables or ranges. It is strongest on the digit right after a decimal point.

modes.label: Decimal digits in organ tables
modes.description: A digit or point inside a decimal value in a list of organ radiation dose figures.

modes.label: Numbers in results or dose ranges
modes.description: A digit in a percentage, range or dose figure within running text.
modes.example: withholding of intravenous atezolizumab in <<1>>.6% of patients.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated corporate-word pieces, so there is no clear link to the numbers.
card.plain: It lights up on digits within decimal numbers, especially in tables of values and result ranges.
